instruction: A candid medium shot of a bright indoor workshop with white wood-paneled walls. On the left, the man with the afro (R2) wearing a gray button-down shirt stands looking at his partner. On the right, the man with the fade haircut (R3) wearing a rust-red turtleneck sweater and a green apron stands facing him, gesturing with his hand near a yellow cylindrical container on the wooden table. They make friendly eye contact. Colorful glass vases and an open laptop sit on the left. Bright natural light fills the room.
